Spiced Cran 'o Rum Bars
By: Angela
Published: Friday, December 3, 2010 - 3:19pm

Ingredients




1 egg, beaten
2 tablespoons water
2 tablespoons packed brown sugar
2/3 cup butter, at room temperature
1/4 cup spiced rum
17 1/2 ounces package oatmeal cookie mix
1 cup dried cranberries
1/2 cup chopped walnuts

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350° F. Spray a 13x9x2-inch baking dish with butter cooking spray. 2 In a large mixing bowl, whisk together egg, water and brown sugar. Add butter and rum. Gradually add oatmeal cookie mix to the sugar mixture and mix well. Fold in cranberries and nuts. 3 Transfer to baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into 24 bars. Cool on a wire rack.
